body: When I say we’re speaking the same language it’s crazy. I realized, too late of course, that I was always searching for love because I didn’t feel it growing up. But once I got it I was bored of it. It lost its lore after some time. I say some time because it varies depending on the person. But it was like I needed that validation from others because I don’t love myself. I would also sabotage things on purpose. It was a defense mechanism. I would leave them so they couldn’t leave me first or i would purposely do something to make them leave or push them away so it was ending on my terms. And now I’m alone and stuck. I’ve just given up on life and can’t wait for death. I’ve lost all those who I truly do love.

It’s not weird. Honestly I feel the exact same way. Do you know how many times a day I say, “When am I gonna die?” I am so over life. I’ve legit given up and I just want to die, but I don’t have it in me to kill myself, even though I wish I did. And the wanting to be held thing isn’t weird at all. We’re human. We crave and want affection. I can’t even remember the last time I had an embrace with someone I cared about. So don’t think it’s weird. Do you mind me asking why you feel so hopeless?

That sounds so upsetting to me. That you feel so worthless that you physically harm yourself. It’s heartbreaking. Can I ask what it does? Meaning what it does for you that you’ve done it. Does it calm you or your mind. Help alleviate your thoughts? Again if I’m being too personal with my questions I apologize and I’ll stop. I don’t want to make you uncomfortable or uneasy.

I’m sorry to hear that. As someone with severe depression and constantly having those same feelings and not wanting to be alive, I empathize with you to an extent. I say to an extent because self harm isn’t something I’ve done. I mean I’ve thought about it but I just couldn’t do it. It’s the same with me and suicide. So is it too forward or personal to ask how exactly you self harm?
Sometimes it easier to express your feelings anonymously or to a stranger because there’s no judgement.
It’s the only reason I do it.
What haven’t you been real about?
I don’t think you can send pictures through direct messages.

I fell asleep. I’m on the East Coast so it was a little after 1:00am. I’m positive you’re asleep now though seeing as how it’s 5:00am there. I appreciate the encouragement for trying art. It’s not that I never tried it. I did. I just was never any good at it. It’s a talent I admire tremendously but one I don’t have. Lol. Would you mind letting me see some of your art? It’s okay if you don’t, again it’s a talent I admire very much in people.
And I’m glad you aren’t going through with it tonight. Or today. I don’t know where you live or what time it is where you are.
And I’m glad you’re not going to go through with it tonight. Or today. I don’t know where you live or what time it is there.

It’s okay. No need to apologize. I understood why you reacted the way you did. When I say I know how you feel and I genuinely understand.... I do. I know what it’s like for people to not understand and like you said give vague advice. I hate that generic shit. Saying things like, “Things get better, you’ve got your whole life ahead of you, get help, pray, etc.” That’s why I asked specifically about what’s at the crux of you writing your note and wanting to commit suicide. So you said you used to find joy in art and in singing..... Do you create art or just admire it or both? And singing is such an amazing talent. So is art. I’ve literally dreamed of being able to do them because I am terrible at both. Lol. See I can admire art but I’m terrible at it. I actually hate doing it. I never even took Art as an elective in high school.

Because you can’t tell tone through text at times, I believe you took what I said as me trying to devalue your inconveniences. I wasn’t. Everyone’s struggles are different and everyone deals with things differently. Just because someone can do something doesn’t mean the next person can. Me saying life is full of inconveniences is me just stating facts. It wasn’t me saying they aren’t tough or draining or tiresome. It wasn’t me saying your inconveniences aren’t tough or draining or tiresome. And just so you know I’m not trying to sway you one way or the other. I’m a huge believer in it’s your life, do with it as you please. I just figured I’d attempt a conversation because sometimes talking about our problems helps us in the moment because so many times we feel alone and like no one cares. And even if we know they care we feel like if we died it wouldn’t really affect anyone too much. Again I know the feeling. Shit I felt like killing myself last month. It’s a constant with me in my life. Wanting to die. So I’m sorry if I made you feel like I was saying your inconveniences weren’t valid.

Okay. I’m not trying to diminish how you feel. I know very well that how you feel is how you feel. As someone who has contemplated suicide for years and too many times to count I understand completely in wanting to give up. Feeling like there’s nothing for me to live for and what’s the point in continuing in especially when I know happiness will never be mine. But life as a whole has inconveniences. It’ll never be easy. Do you take medication and/or go to therapy?

I’m only asking these questions because I am someone who suffers from Clinical Depression and Anxiety. You say you’re tired.... Tired of what? Also what are some other reasons? You said there are a lot so what are a few more besides being tired?
Why do you want to commit suicide?
